backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows. Core uses canonical snapshots; Space variants use the same exp-20260510-028 augmented snapshots. The accepted_before variant reproduces exp-20260511-105 policy semantics.

before_variant.description: accepted exp-20260511-105 semantics: PL/BKSY trend_long keeps the default Space risk scalar; PL/BKSY breakout_long keeps the accepted 0.1x data-vendor breakout scalar

best_variant.description: only PL/BKSY data-vendor trend_long signals use a 1.50x extra risk scalar; all other accepted Space risk and target semantics remain locked

decision_rationale: PL/BKSY data-vendor trend risk scaling did not beat the accepted exp-105 Space stack under the three-window gate. Keep data-vendor trend_long exposure at the accepted default Space risk scalar.

gate_questions.acceptance_standard: Must improve aggregate EV and PnL versus exp-105, improve EV in at least two windows with no EV regression, keep max drawdown drift <= 0.5 pp, and survival >= 5%.
gate_questions.alpha_hypothesis: Bucket-specific risk allocation for data-vendor Space trend_long entries.
prior_similar_experiments: exp-20260511-018 rejected a PL/BKSY trend-only gate, so this run does not delete breakouts or change candidate eligibility.
exp-20260511-019 and exp-20260511-031 accepted a PL/BKSY breakout-only haircut.
exp-20260511-023 rejected a broad remaining-trend top-up as underpowered; this run narrows the causal variable to PL/BKSY trend_long only.
exp-20260511-105 accepted the RKLB/ASTS launch-connectivity trend target extension and remains locked.
gate_questions.reproducibility: This script reruns core, accepted exp-105 Space stack, and PL/BKSY trend risk variants across the three docs/backtesting.md fixed snapshots.
gate_questions.single_causal_variable: Only the PL/BKSY trend_long extra risk scalar changes; all other Space target/risk semantics are locked.

hypothesis: After exp-031 cut PL/BKSY breakout_long risk, the same data-vendor bucket may still contain trend-following alpha. Adjusting only PL/BKSY trend_long risk may improve Space allocation without reopening noisy data-vendor breakouts.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm_soft_ranking: Space forward event ledger still lacks enough mature closed decisions; this run uses deterministic OHLCV lifecycle replay.

next_evidence_needed: If rejected, do not retry nearby PL/BKSY trend risk scalars on the same frozen snapshots; future data-vendor Space work needs forward replacement value or a genuinely new catalyst-quality field.
rejection_reason: PL/BKSY data-vendor trend risk scaling did not beat the accepted exp-105 Space stack under the three-window gate. Keep data-vendor trend_long exposure at the accepted default Space risk scalar.
single_causal_variable: extra risk scalar for PL/BKSY data-vendor trend_long signals inside the default-off official Space sleeve
